purpose: Provider-neutral assurance profile distilled from a production website repair: prove live behaviour, exhaustive coverage, bounded resource use, failure visibility, identity, rollback, and claim accuracy without importing project-specific counts into canon.

entity_coverage.rule: A requirement naming all entities is exhaustive. Samples may discover classes but cannot close the population.

data_authority_and_cache.rule: Keep one durable authority. Caches are derived, versioned, bounded, and negative-cache failures without becoming a second writer.

authorization.rule: Changing requested scopes does not alter old credentials. Reauthorization and provider read-back are separate gates; secret values never enter evidence.

attributed_metric.rule: A proxy total cannot substitute for an attributed metric. Missing join data keeps the metric UNKNOWN and the UI must say why.

ui_field_provenance.rule: Audit each visible field independently; one passing total cannot cover unrelated blank or derived fields.

route_resource_budget.rule: Use the metric named by the contract. Wall time, build size, or total account analytics cannot substitute for route-scoped CPU.

client_request_loop.rule: Every failure path needs negative caching or an equivalent bounded suppressor and a retry ceiling. A read failure must not render as empty success.

deletion_impact.rule: Every deleted artifact receives an individual verdict; a clean compile cannot exclude runtime or external references.

commit_claim.rule: A pushed commit is not correctness evidence. Split every numeric and behavioural claim and rerun it against the claimed revision.

connection_scan.rule: Prove whether limits truncate the population and whether filters discard usable connections.

deployment_receipt.rule: Build, upload, deploy, read-back, and source push are distinct states. Mutable transaction evidence and SCF/AEX/SEAL are reset at the start of every cycle. Authenticated verification enters through the resident auth adapter and the atomically written verifier receipt, not nested-process stdout, is the outcome authority. Completion requires current-cycle evidence for the state named by the outcome.

proves: local CPU build and source push read-back
public, authenticated, immutable-asset, CPU, deployment read-back, and rollback coverage
resident authentication adapter and verifier receipt read-back
current-cycle phase and mutable evidence reset
ztm_deployment_recipe.rule: Recipe coverage is a pre-mutation gate only. It never upgrades a planned command, source marker, or installed skill into live deployment evidence.

handoff_contract.rule: Separate owner-only choices from agent-executable work. Continue safe independent branches and never ask the owner to perform mechanical verification.
